hints.title: Dimensional Orientation Shift
hints.text: Data recorded in narrow long format spreads observations across separate rows. How can distinct categorical values be rotated so that one attribute defines the row index while another forms column titles?

hints.title: Pivot Reshaping
hints.text: Pivoting reorganizes a tabular dataset by transforming unique values of a specified column into new column headers, indexed by another column and populated with a chosen value column.

hints.title: Pivot Parameter Configuration
hints.text: Call the pivot method on the weather DataFrame with index='month', columns='city', and values='temperature'. Return the transformed DataFrame.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Vectorized 2D cross-tabulation pivot on unique index-column pairs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual grouping, nested dictionary accumulation, and manual matrix reshaping takes quadratic interpretation time and fails when duplicate (index, column) pairs exist. Iterating through DataFrame rows is notoriously slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: The vectorized .pivot() engine constructs a 2D index-by-column cross-tabulation in O(N) time with O(U * V) auxiliary memory where U and V are the unique counts of index and column values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Selecting .pivot() when index-column combinations are unique; naming index, columns, and values kwargs accurately.
